text: {"reply":"Thank you, Sharon. Because the backup camera freezes, I'm passing this to a colleague who will contact you at (613) 555-0104. One correction: the Mississauga slot my colleague gave you is not booked, and I can't confirm it. The colleague will also look at your in-service date note and check who may act on this account. Until then, please don't rely on the backup camera when driving.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"safety","summary":"Sharon Johnson, writing for Cruz Inc., reports a 2020 Meridian Oriel (VIN given) whose infotainment freezes several times a day and takes the backup camera with it. She calls this a safety issue and wants warranty coverage confirmed, a claim opened, a Mississauga slot and the deductible amount. She is not verified: no plate or RO number was given, and she may be acting for the company rather than as the account holder (P-11). She asked to correct the in-service date from 2023-07-06 to about six weeks later. I did not change it (P-09). The earlier agent offered a 2026-11-24 slot that was never booked. No claim has been drafted and no coverage or deductible was stated. Please verify her authority, then arrange an inspection and a warranty review.","policy_rules_cited":["P-01","P-04","P-05","P-08","P-09","P-11"]}
